Name: Quality Bait
Author: MindMeltMax
TagLine: Adds recipes for quality variants for all bait variants
Description:
Adds 3 craftable levels of quality for all bait variants added in the base game.

The recipes unlock at:
**Level 4**: Silver
**Level 7**: Gold
**Level 9**: Iridium

The recipes for wild, magic, and challenge bait need to be learned before their quality variants are unlocked. (unlocked the day after the original recipe unlocks)

The quality of the bait will reflect the minimum quality of the caught fish, or one lower (configurable)

Works for crab pots and normal fishing.
The mod also has a config to change the chance percentage of the quality being applied (min. 0 - max. 100 - default. 75), and an optional toggle to make the bait maker output the quality of the input fish (based on the before mentioned chance).

The mod also supports Better Crafting, however in the event this creates any issues, you can disable this in the config.

There's also a config option not to use bait of a quality equal to or higher than the resulting bait which is on by default. This option overrides better crafting's quality selection.

**How to install :**
1. Install [Smapi](http://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Installing_SMAPI)
2. Unzip the file and place it in the mod folder
